**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.

* Knowledge of Group Policy Objects (GPOs), shared file systems, user and access management, software installation, configuration, and system administration.
* Ability to troubleshoot operating system, application, and patch installation issues.

* Ability to develop, test, and maintain automation scripts for vulnerability remediation, patch deployment, software upgrades, and compliance validation.

* Application Packaging and Software Deployment

* Experience preparing, testing, and deploying third-party and open-source software updates across enterprise server environments.
* Ability to analyze application installation requirements, dependencies, compatibility considerations, and potential operational impacts.
* Understanding of software versioning, package management, installation parameters, and silent installation techniques.
* Experience with BigFix or similar tools for software distribution and deployment is desirable.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager – Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture with strong NetSuite integration expertise to design, develop, and maintain enterprise integrations, APIs, EDI, and data pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills and a solid understanding of distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. This role focuses on hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership rather than project management.

**Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise integration architecture**

* Design and maintain the company's enterprise integration architecture, including approved patterns for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events, and batch processing.
* Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, timing, sequencing, validation, error handling, retry, reconciliation, security, and support ownership for each interface.
* Avoid uncontrolled point-to-point connections, duplicated business logic, and integrations that create parallel systems of record.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records, and runbooks while determining which existing interfaces should be retained, redesigned, replaced, or retired.

**NetSuite integration engineering**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support integrations between NetSuite and internal or external systems.
* Develop deep knowledge of the NetSuite record, transaction, permission, and posting models so interfaces create valid operational and accounting results.
* Work with applicable NetSuite capabilities such as REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, web services, and token-based authentication.
* Use Oracle integration technologies where appropriate, establish reusable engineering patterns, and challenge partner-proposed designs before owning the deployed solution and support model.

**Customer vendor and external ecosystem integration**

* Support EDI and API connectivity for customers, broadline distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services, websites, and other business partners.
* Design mappings and workflows for relevant documents such as purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, item data, pricing, and order status.
* Support vendor onboarding, customer enablement, item synchronization, pricing exchange, order ingestion, fulfillment status, and other digital transaction flows while keeping partner-specific rules documented and controlled.
* Build repeatable onboarding patterns that reduce the cost and time required to connect new customers, vendors, and acquisitions.

**Data architecture ownership and governance**

* Help define company's enterprise data architecture with NetSuite as the authoritative transactional platform for the processes it owns.
* Establish clear boundaries for transactional, master, analytical, historical, reference, and external application data.
* Partner with business and application owners to define authoritative sources, data ownership, approval rights, stewardship, quality rules, and lifecycle requirements.
* Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions, and reconciliations so critical item, pricing, costing, inventory, margin, customer, vendor, and financial logic remains transparent and auditable.

**Legacy discovery migration and transition**

* Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files, and automated jobs to identify embedded business rules and technical dependencies.
* Document why existing functionality exists before replacing it, separating requirements that must be preserved from obsolete workarounds and technical debt.
* Support extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with repeatable utilities and control totals that preserve financial, operational, and referential integrity.
* Plan retirement, archival, access, and support arrangements for legacy data and applications that will not move into the future environment.

**Analytics data services and application enablement**

* Support the architecture and ongoing operation of NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted.
* Define the appropriate roles of NetSuite native reporting, governed analytical platforms, Power BI, and other reporting tools so business logic is not recreated inconsistently.
* Design data models and pipelines that provide trusted reporting and reconcile to source transactions.
* Support approved extension platforms for internal tools, portals, and workflows, and enable automation or AI only through governed data, controlled interfaces, clear ownership, and appropriate human review.

**Testing monitoring security and operational support**

* Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover, and reconciliation testing with documented acceptance criteria.
* Implement logging, automated alerts, transaction tracing, exception queues, retry mechanisms, dashboards, and escalation procedures so failures are visible and actionable.
* Perform hands-on production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across systems, data, network, authentication, mapping, sequencing, and business-rule layers.
* Apply secure access and data protection while establishing standards for source control, code review, automated testing, environment separation, deployment, versioning, rollback, documentation, and change control.

**Long term architecture ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner for enterprise integrations, data pipelines, interface standards, and supporting technical documentation.
* Work side by side with implementation-partner engineers during design and build activities rather than receiving knowledge only at the end of the program.
* Build internal support capability, reduce unnecessary dependence on external consultants, and prioritize technical debt and enhancements based on business value, reliability, control risk, total cost, and operational impact.
* Create scalable patterns that support growth, acquisition integration, customer and vendor enablement, analytics, automation, and future digital services

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering, or related technical experience.
* Meaningful hands-on experience integrating with NetSuite and working with its records, transactions, permissions, APIs, or scripting capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, SQL, SFTP, webhooks, authentication, and modern integration patterns.
* Experience designing, building, testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience with data mapping, transformation, migration, reconciliation, master data, and data-quality controls.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills across applications, interfaces, data, security, and business processes.
* Experience with API security, token-based authentication, source control, code review, testing, deployment, environment management, and operational documentation.
* Ability to understand order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, fulfillment, and accounting impacts in addition to technical specifications.
* Ability to evaluate and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations and assume ownership of the resulting design.
* Strong written communication and willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operation of the environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), NetSuite Integration Platform, and other Oracle integration technologies.
* Experience with SuiteTalk, SuiteScript, RESTlets, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, or NetSuite Analytics Warehouse.
* Knowledge of EDI standards and third-party integration processes.
* Experience in food distribution, wholesale distribution, retail, logistics, or other transaction-intensive industries.
* Experience modernizing Microsoft Dynamics GP or custom legacy applications.
* Familiarity with Oracle APEX, Power BI, cloud data platforms, workflow automation, or document processing.
* Experience with multi-entity environments, acquisitions, and high-volume order and inventory transactions.

title: Senior Database Engineer
description:
**Ready to Help Shape the Future of Legal Tech?!**
At Litera, we don't just build software — we transform how the world's top law firms operate. Every day, we Raise The Bar™ for what's possible through AI, innovation, and solutions that power millions of legal professionals worldwide. If you're energized by scale, real impact, and meaningful challenges, you'll feel right at home here.
  
  
**Where You'll Work**
Hybrid: This is a hybrid role based in Ahmedabad with the expectation to be in office at least 3 days a week for collaboration and connection.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
As a Senior Database Engineer, you'll be the driving force behind the performance, reliability, and scalability of the databases that power Litera's SaaS platform — used daily by millions of legal professionals worldwide.
  
  
You'll partner closely with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to shape data architecture decisions that directly impact customer experience and platform uptime. This is a high-visibility role where your deep expertise across database platforms — PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MySQL — will influence how we build and scale our next generation of cloud-native solutions on Azure and AWS.
  
  
If you thrive on solving complex data challenges across multiple database engines and want your work to have real, measurable impact, this is the opportunity for you.
  
  
**What You'll Deliver**

* Ensure Litera's critical SaaS databases run at peak performance through expert-level tuning, monitoring, and optimization across PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and/or MySQL — directly improving platform reliability for millions of users.
* Design and implement database schemas and data ingest strategies that scale with our growing product portfolio and customer base, leveraging the strengths of each database platform.
* Drive root cause analysis during major incidents and lead cross-functional resolution efforts, minimizing customer impact and strengthening system resilience.
* Implement advanced security standards — including row-level security and data encryption — to protect sensitive legal data and maintain compliance.
* Architect backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions across Azure and AWS cloud environments that ensure business continuity and give stakeholders confidence in our platform.
* Automate routine database operations to reduce toil, increase reliability, and free up engineering capacity for higher-impact work.
* Review and improve database code across teams, mentoring engineers on best practices and elevating the quality of our data layer.
* Stay ahead of emerging database technologies and cloud-managed database services, bringing forward recommendations that keep Litera at the cutting edge.

**What You'll Bring**
**Must-Haves**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Database Administrator or Database Engineer, with strong foundational knowledge of database engine internals and fundamentals across PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MySQL.
* Subject Matter Expert (SME) in at least one major database platform (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL), with demonstrated deep expertise in performance tuning, architecture, and production-grade operations on that platform.
* Proven database management experience in Azure or AWS cloud environments, including managed database services (e.g., Azure SQL Database, Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, Azure Database for PostgreSQL/MySQL, Azure SQL Managed Instance).
* Proven ability to write, debug, and optimize complex database queries and code across multiple database dialects.
* Query optimization expertise: Deep proficiency in analyzing execution plans, identifying bottlenecks, and rewriting queries for optimal performance. Ability to leverage indexing strategies, query hints, and platform-specific optimizer features across PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MySQL to ensure consistent, high-throughput database operations.
* Database migration specialist: Hands-on experience planning and executing database migrations — including cross-platform migrations (e.g., SQL Server to PostgreSQL, on-premises to cloud), major version upgrades, and schema evolution strategies — with minimal downtime and data integrity assurance. Familiarity with migration tooling such as AWS DMS, Azure Database Migration Service, pgLoader, or equivalent.
* Solid understanding of database engine tuning, partitioning strategies, and physical schema design from logical models.
* A problem-solver who can reverse-engineer issues, simplify complexity, and communicate clearly under pressure.
* Comfort with on-call rotations and the ability to maintain composure during high-urgency production incidents.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Database certifications in the required platforms (e.g., PostgreSQL Certified Professional, Microsoft Certified: SQL Server/Azure SQL, Oracle MySQL Certified Professional) or AWS and Azure cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Database — Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect). Strongly preferred.
* Additional cloud platform certifications (Azure, AWS) or multi-cloud database management experience.
* Experience with data modeling, master data management (MDM), or data dictionaries.
* Background working with SaaS products in highly regulated environments (SOX, HIPAA, PCI).
* Familiarity with software development practices and workflows.
* Knowledge of security and privacy compliance frameworks.
* Adaptability and a passion for learning new tools and technologies. Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as New Relic, Datadog, Grafana, or similar tools to proactively identify performance trends, anomalies, and infrastructure health across database environments.

*Great candidates don't check every box — if this role excites you and you bring most of what we're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.*
**What You'll Experience**

* A team that shows up. Work alongside people who collaborate, support one another, and lead with integrity.
* Global Reach. Partner with teams around the world to solve complex challenges that matter.
* Real opportunity for growth. Expand your impact through meaningful stretch opportunities, visibility and career development.
* AI-driven innovation. Work at the intersection of legal technology, customer outcomes, and cutting-edge AI.

Litera is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Precisely/Evolve MDM Analyst will serve as e.l.f. Beauty’s primary technical owner of the Precisely/Evolve platform, driving data quality, enrichment, and master data management across customer, vendor, and product domains. This is a platform-forward role for someone who is hands-on with Precisely/Evolve workflows and brings the analytical mindset to continuously improve data health at scale. Experience with SAP master data is strongly encouraged — the two platforms are closely linked in our environment — and candidates who bring dual platform fluency will have a meaningful advantage. **Responsibilities**
**Precisely/Evolve Platform - Primary Focus**

**MDM Domain Knowledge — Required Foundation**

* Apply master data management principles across customer, vendor, and product domains to define what “good data” looks like — including data standards, field-level rules, hierarchy structures, and source-of-truth logic
* Design matching and survivorship rules grounded in business context: understanding which record wins, why, and what the downstream impact is if that logic is wrong
* Develop and enforce data quality thresholds by domain, with clear understanding of business consequences for each type of quality failure
* Partner with data owners to define and document master data standards that translate directly into platform configuration

**Cross-Domain Data Stewardship**
  
  

+ Apply technical and domain expertise across all three master data domains — customer, vendor, and product — ensuring consistency, completeness, and accuracy across platforms and downstream systems
+ Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT to understand domain-specific requirements and translate them into technical rules, validation logic, and platform configuration
+ Collaborate with IT on integration design to ensure Precisely/Evolve outputs flow correctly into connected systems including SAP

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience with Precisely (formerly Syncsort/Trillium) or Evolve, including workflow configuration, data quality rule development, and platform administration — required
* Demonstrated MDM domain knowledge across one or more of the following: customer master, vendor master, product/material master — required. Breadth across all three is a strong plus
* Ability to design matching, survivorship, and enrichment logic from first principles — not just execute pre-built configurations — required
* Experience with SAP master data management (Material Master, Customer Master, and/or Vendor Master) strongly preferred; dual Precisely/Evolve + SAP experience is a significant differentiator
* Proven ability to identify data quality gaps and proactively drive platform or process improvements
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to data detail and integrity
* Ability to work cross-functionally with business and IT teams, translating technical concepts clearly for non-technical audiences
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to collaborate effectively across time zones with global teams
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP MDG (Master Data Governance), or data integration middleware a plus
* Beauty, retail, or consumer packaged goods industry background preferred but not required

**Technical Skills**

* Precisely/Evolve — workflow configuration, data quality rules, enrichment, matching, and survivorship (required)
* MDM domain knowledge — customer, vendor, and/or product/material master (required)
* SAP ERP / S/4HANA — Material Master, Customer Master, and/or Vendor Master (strongly preferred)
* SQL or equivalent querying tools for data analysis and investigation
* Data integration concepts and API-based or batch data flows
* Microsoft Excel (advanced) for data analysis, reconciliation, and reporting
